description: SPIN-ISOLATION TEST — every kick gets a huge CONSTANT sideways SPIN, while the aim stays normal. Forces the cave's delta to a fixed +15deg (ignoring the real body angle) and raises K_SIDE 0.5 -> 2.0, so omega.y gains a constant +30 on every kick: a_side ~7.6 m/s^2 (0.77g) => roughly 5m of curve over a 1.2s flight, always the same direction. Passes should fly out roughly where aimed and then BANANA sideways. This isolates SPIN from directional error (aim is untouched). Remove with: exe_patch.py remove tools/data/patches/test-spin.json

patches.name: TEST: force cave delta to a constant +15deg
